title: Observational Learning and Information Disclosure in Search Markets
authors: Ziying Fan; Xi Weng; Li-An Zhou; Yiyi Zhou
department: marketing (per abstract: accepted by Raphael Thomadsen)
eligible_reason: Structural model of buyers' observational learning, search and bidding in housing markets estimated by maximum likelihood (MATLAB); counterfactual disclosure-rule simulations. No regression, no DiD. The package contains only simulated data and MATLAB code; the regressions list is empty.
design_notes: codes/estimation_main.m estimates the model on data/data_sim.mat (1,000 simulated properties generated by data_simulation.m); CF.m runs counterfactuals.
data_files: data/data_sim.mat (SIMULATED; proprietary home-viewing and transaction data not provided under a Department Editor exemption)
data_files_note: README: 'we supply detailed instructions for generating a simulated dataset that replicates the structure and variables of the original data'.
priority_note: Not a DiD paper; simulated data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). README extracted from the archive zip to the scratchpad.
